name: tela
title: tela
description: Your tela wiki in the panel: full-text search, semantic research with sources, recent pages and favourites, spaces, decks, sheets, mentions and replies, backlinks; new pages from what you selected.
author: pal

settings.label: Address
settings.description: The tela instance: https://telawiki.com, or your own.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: A personal access token from Settings, API Keys on tela (tela_pat_...). Read scope lists and searches; write scope creates pages and comments.

settings.label: Default space
settings.description: The space New tela page offers first: its name, slug or id. Empty picks the first space.

settings.label: Research
settings.description: Needs an embedder configured on the instance; Search works without one.

search.title: Search tela
search.description: Full-text over every page you can see, ranked, with the matching passage; sections by space.

keys.title: Copy the markdown (from the page read in pal)

research.title: Ask tela
research.description: A question answered by meaning: the pages that matter assembled with their sources, disagreements flagged, low confidence said.

keys.title: Ask; on a source, open it in tela
Ask in the browser; on a source, read it in pal
Open the question in tela Ask

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Favourites, then what changed lately across spaces; New tela page, Search tela, Ask tela (the question typed in the bar) and Quick Notes at the top. From Spaces, one space's pages.

keys.title: Copy the markdown (from the page read in pal)

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.description: Every space the token sees, with its page count; Enter lists its pages.

new-page.title: New Page
new-page.description: A page in a space of your choice: title, space, body prefilled from your selection or the clipboard.

decks.title: Decks
decks.description: Slide decks across spaces, newest first; the pane shows the first slide.

keys.title: Read the deck's markdown in pal
Copy the markdown (from the page read in pal)

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.description: Spreadsheet pages across spaces, newest first.

keys.title: Read the sheet's markdown in pal
Copy the markdown (from the page read in pal)

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Mentions of you and replies to your comments, unread first; opening one marks it read.

keys.title: Mark read and open the page

backlinks.title: Backlinks
backlinks.description: What links to the page you opened last, or to the page a row's cmd+b came from.

keys.title: Open the linking page in tela
Copy the markdown (from the page read in pal)

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Unread mentions and replies as a badge, hidden at zero; the popover lists the newest five as rows — the kind's glyph, what happened, the comment's snippet, the time — with a cursor the arrows move and a click sets.

keys.title: Open the focused comment in tela
Mark every mention and reply read
Open the Comments palette in pal
Move between the rows; a click on a row focuses it

store.tagline: Your tela wiki: search, research, pages, spaces, inbox
features: Search tela as you type: ranked full-text hits with the matching passage, sectioned by space; cmd+Enter reads the page inside pal
Ask tela: a question answered by meaning, the sources as rows with the cited excerpt, disagreements and low confidence flagged
Pages: favourites first, then what changed across every space; a page read in pal keeps headings, lists, callouts, code and tables in the tokens
Spaces with page counts, Decks with the first slide in the pane, Sheets, Backlinks of the page you opened last
New tela page as a form, the body from your selection or the clipboard; Comment on a page anchored on its text
Comments: mentions of you and replies to your comments; the bar item counts them and hides at zero
